title: Add slide-in detail panels (sheets) for rich step editing

summary.goal: Add slide-in detail panels (sheets) for rich step editing and inspection.

acceptance_criteria.description: SheetContainer slides in from the right edge with subtle drop shadow overlay
StepSheet contains: title (editable), scope, owner role, description, dependencies, acceptance criteria, execution info, traceability section
Clicking a step at STEP zoom level opens its StepSheet
Sheet has a focused chat input at the bottom (messages flow to main conversation)
Sheets are always user-initiated (click), never AI-triggered
Close button returns to tree view at STEP zoom
AcceptanceCriteriaSection (from planner-ui) renders inside sheet, not inline in tree

observations: Sheets are the primary surface for rich detail and editing. They're essentially the expanded view that planner-ui's StepEditor provides, but as a slide-in panel rather than inline.
The sheet pattern (slide from right, overlay) is common in modern UIs — similar to Notion's page peek or Linear's issue detail.

steps.title: Create SheetContainer with slide-in animation
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/sheets/SheetContainer.tsx. Slide-in panel from right edge, drop shadow overlay, close button (X) in top-right. Use Framer Motion or CSS transitions. Z-index above tree but below status bar.

steps.title: Create StepSheet with full step detail
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/sheets/StepSheet.tsx. Copy AcceptanceCriteriaSection from packages/planner-ui/src/components/acceptance-criteria/AcceptanceCriteriaSection.tsx. Layout sections: title (EditableText), scope (read-only badge), owner role (read-only), description (EditableText), dependencies (DependencyIndicator list), acceptance criteria (AcceptanceCriteriaSection).

steps.title: Add execution info and traceability sections to StepSheet
steps.description: In StepSheet: add Execution Info section (agent name, status, progress %, time elapsed). Add Traceability section (links to PRs, commits, related messages). Both render empty states when no data. Reference forge artifact structure.

steps.title: Add focused chat input at bottom of sheet
steps.description: In StepSheet bottom: add ConversationInput variant (smaller, labeled 'Ask about this step'). Messages sent from here flow to main conversation with step_ref metadata. Copy input component from ConversationPane.

steps.title: Wire sheet open interaction from tree
steps.description: In StepNode component: when zoom level is STEP, add onClick → open StepSheet. Pass step data to sheet. Sheet state managed in ProjectContext. Clicking close → sheet slides out, tree remains at STEP zoom.

architect.trigger: click step at STEP zoom level
architect.pattern: slide-in panel from right, not modal

interaction.close: close button returns to STEP zoom
interaction.chat: input at bottom sends to main conversation
